title: The Beck–Fiala Conjecture
statement_plain: Given any finite hypergraph (set system) in which every element belongs to at most t sets (maximum degree t), there exists a red/blue coloring chi: V -> {-1, +1} such that every set S has discrepancy |sum_{v in S} chi(v)| = O(sqrt(t)) — independent of the number of elements n and sets m.
